title: recordCommandAnalytics
responsibility: Skips lookup-only CLI arguments and otherwise records command action, exit code, and elapsed time through the supplied or default analytics recorder.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.args
inputs.description: CLI arguments used to identify lookup-only commands that should not create an event.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.startedAt
inputs.description: Start time in epoch milliseconds used to compute elapsed duration.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.exitCode
inputs.description: Command result code; nullish values are recorded as zero.

inputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics.record
inputs.description: Optional recorder override; defaults to recordAnalytics.

outputs.name: recordCommandAnalytics
outputs.description: Resolves after the command event is recorded, or immediately when skipsAnalytics is true.
